fields.title: Reversible or not
fields.inputs/1/label: Record purchase on order, not on line item
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Record purchase event on order, not on each line item
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Use email as primary user key
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/3: Store price as an integer number of kopecks instead of fractional
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/4: Treat branch as tenant, not the entire chain
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 and 4 are reversible — it's work, data is not lost. 2 (no retroactive granularity, history lost forever), 3 (key leaks outside), 5 (rebuilds the entire rights system and all references) are irreversible. Criterion: is data lost irretrievably. The volume of work does not make a decision irreversible.
